tier_rationale: Deliberately not decidable from a static read alone, unlike the earlier fixtures (which each had one objectively-wrong token). This bug changes two individually-plausible CSS values in the same row — alignItems: 'center' -> 'flex-end' AND the badge's padding: '2px 8px' -> '14px 20px' — neither of which is a type error or an obviously invalid value on its own. The row only visibly misaligns because the enlarged badge creates cross-axis slack that flex-end then exposes; verified empirically (offset ~0px on HEAD, ~13px with both changes applied). A model has no way to be confident a proposed fix is correct without rendering and measuring — this directly probes harness-bench-analysis.md's core thesis about runtime signal value.
